prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit supplied image 1 only; images 2–3 are fixed character/book references. Preserve every character pose, expression, hand contact, exact block count and road state, red truck position and scene composition relationships. Widen the view by about 15 percent, extending the existing floor and wall naturally, so both children's ENTIRE shoes/hair/hands and all story props are at least 8 percent away from every canvas edge. Specifically no shoe should lie near the left or right edge. No white border or framed inset: still one full-bleed 3:2 landscape classroom scene. Keep clean flat color fills and crisp outlines, no grain/noise or added texture. Do not add/remove/move blocks relative to one another, do not change the gap or its filled state, do not add extra people or writing. The source image is otherwise correct.
